scene: Ten nights of sandbox declarations. sandbox was declared on the Monday, declared again on the Wednesday once the api image bump had been accepted, put back on the first declaration on the Friday while the change board was still looking at that bump, and back on the second declaration on the Sunday. The first declaration was deleted on the Monday after that and the second on the Wednesday. sandbox-eu was declared once and left alone throughout. pilot was declared on the Thursday with nothing running in it yet, and scanned on the Friday. The numbers the old shell script wrote are printed next to this build's, including the one it wrote for sandbox on the night after the second declaration went.
